messages:
alyssa: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need clear owners + Jira tickets for the cache-thundering regression (03/10). Please claim the items below by EOD Wed so we can close the remediation sprint. Target: full remediation and runbook updates by 2025-03-31.

alyssa: Action list:
• owner + jira for eviction policy tuning
• owner + jira for oncall runbook & playbook
• owner + jira for alerting threshold tuning
• owner + jira for long-term KV-cache redesign (investigation)
• cross-team handoff plan once stabilized

kevin: I'll take "eviction policy tuning". Creating the ticket now.
kevin: created INF-1247 https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1247 — assigned to me, ETA 2025-03-25. I'll post a short implementation plan later today. :white_check_mark:

maya: I'll own the runbook/playbook updates and the canary checklist for deploys. Creating INF-1248.
maya: INF-1248 https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1248 — pairing with @nora from platform for validation. ETA 2025-03-28.

sana: I'll do alerting threshold tuning (noise reduction + smarter grouping). Need @liam to review the proposed deltas.
sana: opened INF-1249 for alert tuning: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1249 — ETA 2025-03-22 for initial tuning, then iterate.

liam: Reviewing threshold history now. Initial suggestion: increase prefix-miss alert threshold to 15% over a rolling 5m window, and add a suppressed-alert during cache-warmup period (first 10m). I'll comment on INF-1249 with data.

nora: For the KV-cache redesign investigation (long-term), I can start scoping but will need compute estimates. Suggest we spin up a spike: INF-1250.
nora: created INF-1250 https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1250 — spike to evaluate async eviction, sharded caches, and prefix-aware caching. ETA for spike proposal: 2025-04-11.

alyssa: RACI for this set (working draft):
• Eviction tuning — R: kevin, A: platform eng (nora), C: runtime team (liam), I: SRE (sana)
• Runbook/playbook — R: maya, A: SRE lead, C: oncall guild, I: product
• Alert tuning — R: sana, A: SRE lead, C: runtime, I: ops
• KV redesign spike — R: nora, A: eng-manager, C: research/infra, I: product

kevin: Note on handoff: after eviction changes are validated on Dedicated, I'll transfer maintenance to platform team (owner change tracked in INF-1247). Adding a checklist to the ticket: deploy plan, canary gates, rollback criteria.

maya: Can we schedule a 30min remediation sync this week to walk tickets and make sure no overlap? Ops-bot: puts poll below. @ops-bot please schedule something.

ops-bot: Poll: suggested times for remediation sync — Thu 10:00am PST, Fri 9:00am PST. Vote with :thumbsup: or :hand:

sana: thumbsup for Thu 10am.
liam: will make Thu 10am work.
kevin: Thu 10 works for me too.

alyssa: Recurring incident note: this is the second cache-thundering event in ~6 weeks. I've opened INF-1251 for a recurrence analysis to identify systemic triggers and runbook gaps. Assigning @maya to lead the recurrence RCA.

maya: ACK, will pull logs + request KV telemetry for the last 3 months. INF-1251 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1251 — ETA 2025-03-31 for initial findings.

nora: Suggest adding a mitigation flag in the console to temporarily reduce aggressive prefetching when upstream load spikes. I'll add this as a subtask on INF-1250.

kevin: quick note — when you create Jira subtasks, please include the CLI snippet so oncall can see the quick rollback steps. Example I pasted in INF-1247:
```
# quick rollback
kubectl scale deployment cache-runtime --replicas=2 --namespace=dedicated-prod
# disable aggressive prefix prefetch
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://console.api/redwood/v1/flags/cache_prefetch -d '{"value":false}'
```

maya: Thanks — I'll paste rollback steps into INF-1248 too.
